in_force_since_evidence.quoted_span: (“Just Cause Required for Termination of Tenancy” added 5-25-2023 by O-21647 N.S.; effective 6-24-2023.)

result.prior_version_note: § 98.0704 was added by O-21647 N.S. (adopted 5-25-2023, effective 6-24-2023) and amended by O-21769 N.S. (adopted 2-27-2024, effective 3-28-2024). The documents do not say what the 2023 version of § 98.0704 said before that amendment. The Division descends from the 'Tenants' Right to Know Regulations' added 3-30-2004 by O-19269 N.S., but the documents do not describe their content. It is therefore unknown whether a just-cause requirement existed before 2023, which is why requirement_is_new is null.
